notes:
POC scoped for Private (customer VPC) deployment. Customer: Emberwind runs predictive maintenance across EMEA manufacturing sites; strong requirement for EU residency and audit trails. Quick summary:
- Wants full control: customer-managed VPC in AWS account, use of their KMS CMKs (cross-account support required).
- POC objectives: deploy Redwood Private control plane components into their account via Terraform + Helm, validate end-to-end inference (chat + embeddings) over private endpoints, confirm audit logging (immutable logs to S3 + CloudTrail), and verify KMS envelope key workflow.
- Security review status: initial questionnaire completed (drive doc). Security team asked for network diagram, minimal port list, and IAM role policies. We supplied templates; customer asked for example KMS resource policy.
- Quote from Security lead: "We cannot accept any plaintext model cache offloaded outside EU; must prove KV cache pads and encryption" — implies we must document cache encryption and retention.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high; willing to pay for Dedicated-style SLAs but wants predictable ARR.
- Timeline expectation from customer: 4-week POC then signed SOW for 12-month deployment if pass.
- Internal notes: SE to prepare terraform modules in customer account, include outputs for CloudTrail S3 bucket and KMS key alias. Bring in Solutions Architect for KMS policy review.
